blocked.title: Your account is blocked
blocked.tiktokReuse: The TikTok account you connected has already been used in Blast — on a different account. All accounts linked to it are therefore blocked.
blocked.tiktokReuseWhy: The per-track unlimited allowance is unlocked by connecting TikTok, and each TikTok account unlocks it once. Holding several accounts as one person is the breach itself, so the block covers all of them, not only the latest one (section 9 of the Terms).
blocked.generic: The account is blocked for breaching the service rules.
blocked.appeal: Think this is a mistake? Write to us and we will look into it:

stats.title: Statistics
stats.insightHint: {{count}} videos with your own sources beat the rest
stats.leadingHint: “{{value}}” gets {{lift}}% more than the rest. Measured across {{videos}} published clips — parameter by parameter, not as a bundle

stats.iterationHint: We'll keep the sources and test new subtitles

stats.collectingLeftText: Once each value has {{count}} clips, we will show what actually worked: footage, subtitles or the hook — each on its own, not as a bundle.

processing.notFoundText: The link is stale or the generation was not saved. Open the project — finished videos live there.
processing.failedText: Some videos did not render. You can run the batch again — spent credits are returned.
